restrictions: Both colliding messages are exactly 64 bytes: 32 zero bytes followed by a 32-byte little-endian value. They differ in the last 32 bytes.
Full 256-bit digest collision of the three-round target; one compression per message with counter 0, block length 64, flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT.
Single sequential run with a hard step budget of 2^128.03826 compressions; no restart, no parallelism, no preprocessing, no advice.
Generic birthday-bound search. This entry does not improve the nominal reference blake3-r3-nominal-v2; that identifier is named because the schema requires one.

heuristics.statement: For F(x) = three-round BLAKE3 digest of the 64-byte message 0^32 || x, the distinguished-point collision search of proof.md Section 3, with fresh-evaluation budget M = 2^128.03 (M^2/2^257 = 0.5213), theta = 2^-115 and trail cap 2^119, has success probability p_F at least p_rand, the success probability of the same algorithm on a uniformly random function from 256-bit words to 256-bit words. p_rand >= 0.4047 is computed in Section 6 from the birthday bound and geometric trail lengths; no other property of F is used anywhere in the entry.
heuristics.scope: Used only for the success probability (Section 6: birthday bound 6.1 and loss ledger 6.2) and the table occupancy bound (Section 4). Not used for the time ledger (hard budget) or the memory ledger (fixed allocation). Sensitivity (6.4): the claim survives a collision density down to about 0.95 of random; the 0.39 floor is crossed at 0.9.
heuristics.extrapolation: The organizer-executed experiments run the same algorithm with the same parameter rule (M_w^2/2^(w+1) = 0.5213) on F truncated to its first w bits for w = 12, 16, 18, and compare the host-verified success count out of 256 with the author-measured random-function value q_w (0.3357, 0.3863, 0.3924); fewer than 67, 79, 81 successes respectively refutes H1 at that width. The claim applies the same statistics at w = 256, 238 bits beyond the tested widths; the loss terms that keep q_w below 0.4062 at small widths scale as 2^(-w/2) and are negligible at full width (Section 6.2). Structure giving more collisions than random makes the search faster, not slower; the guarded failure mode is fewer collisions or non-random cycle structure.
heuristics.limitations: A width-18 check cannot exclude full-width structure, and three-round BLAKE3 has weak diffusion in its last round. 256 trials have a frequency standard deviation of about 0.03 and cannot resolve a 5 percent density deficit even at the tested width. The author-run reference values q_w and the instance spreads are not organizer-verified. The intervals do not establish p_F >= 0.4047 at any width; no full-width evidence is producible, and this is the obligation every birthday-bound entry on this lane carries.
